metadata.title: Neil Armstrong's Spacecraft Spun Out of Control
metadata.description:
Gemini 8 began spinning violently in orbit. The cause: a stuck-open orbital attitude thruster causing a rapidly increasing spin.

Failure chain: Docked with target → Thruster sticks on → Undocking makes it worse → Spin nears blackout levels → Re-entry thrusters used to stop it

Related episode: 28 Volts vs 65: Apollo 13's Hidden Flaw — https://youtu.be/uqoAjXMbbls

Technical references:
• Wikipedia — Gemini 8 — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gemini_8
• NASA — 25015 (cited by Wikipedia) — https://mira.hq.nasa.gov/history/ws/hdmshrc/all/main/DDD/25015.PDF

Narration uses a synthetic voice. Original animation: no archival or stock footage; reconstructions and illustrations are labelled on screen.
